dataModel.historicData: Stored locally and treated as fixed unless deliberately rebuilt.
dataModel.currentSeasonData: Fetched from the league API by the update script.
dataModel.combinedStats: Calculated from historic data plus current season data.
dataModel.currentSeason: Determined by the update script from the configured current-season setting or league source.
dataModel.note: Current-season records are not copied into historic data until that season is deliberately archived.
